name: khazad_adept
description: a Khazad Adept, a stout dwarf mage: a big braided red beard, a deep golden-yellow hooded robe with grey trim, a brown belt with a gold buckle, a brown leather satchel stuffed with scrolls at his screen-left hip, brown boots, and a wooden staff with a gold-wrapped head topped with a glowing pale-blue crystal in his LEFT hand
hands: the crystal-topped staff stays upright in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand is an empty fist resting at his belly above the satchel on the screen-left side

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; hooded head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (his empty right fist flung out to the left, the crystal-topped staff thrown up and out in his left hand), the red beard and the hood jolting
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the crystal-topped staff leaning out to the right, his empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, staff arm flung up holding the crystal-topped staff high, his empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, hooded head droops, the crystal-topped staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the crystal end of the staff resting on the ground, his empty right hand hanging by the satchel
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the crystal-topped staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the yellow robe flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the hood still over his head and the red beard on his chest; the crystal-topped staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the satchel of scrolls lies flat beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the hood and the yellow robe settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the red beard on his chest, the crystal-topped staff on the ground beside him
